public_body: Great Barrington Housing Authority Board Of Commissioners
overall: The AG found the Housing Authority Board violated the Open Meeting Law because a quorum of its members (now all former) deliberated outside a noticed meeting on a March 2022 letter to DHCD, though no current member was involved.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged three former members deliberated outside a posted meeting in preparing and sending a March 2022 letter to DHCD about Housing Authority concerns.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (ordered).
Caution that a future similar violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law (caution, not an order).
Recommendation that all Board members attend an Open Meeting Law webinar training, and reminder to review prior determinations under the certification requirement (recommendation).
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Board that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
